author: B. H. Barrera
title: Franklin Academy High School reports 4 Black students in 2025-26 enrollment
text:
Franklin Academy High School enrolled four Black students in the 2025-26 school year, reflecting a 33.3% increase from the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department.
The school’s total student population reached 699 for the 2025-26 school year. Black students represented 0.6% of that number, making them the second least common ethnicity in the school.
This institution is part of Malone Central School District, with its main office located in Malone.
Of the district’s five schools, Malone Middle School had the highest Black student enrollment during that period, with five students.
New York ranks second nationwide in K-12 public education spending, recording an average expenditure of $30,012 per student, which is almost twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
| Year | Total School Enrollment | Number of Black Students | Black Students % |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-26 | 699 | 4 | 0.6% |
| 2024-25 | 705 | 3 | 0.4% |
| 2023-24 | 683 | 4 | 0.6% |
| 2022-23 | 719 | 4 | 0.6% |
Information in this article was obtained from the New York State Education Department. The source data can be found here.
